name: Timeouts + Bulkheads
summary: Add timeouts and bulkheads to prevent slow dependencies from consuming all resources and increasing tail latency.

use_when.message: Elevated request latency benefits from strict timeouts and isolation.

avoid_when.message: If errors are already very high, verify upstream retries and dependency availability to avoid amplifying failures.

solutions: Set explicit client and server timeouts for all outbound calls
Use separate connection pools / worker pools per dependency (bulkheads)
Add retry budgets and circuit breakers for flaky dependencies
tradeoffs: More failure modes (timeouts) require fallback behavior
Risk of retry storms if misconfigured
